title: GLP-1 receptor agonists for type 2 diabetes mellitus (adult)
note: TEST FIXTURE: the supplied policy plus a sixth criterion (BMI), to prove a new criterion of an existing kind needs no code change.

status_semantics.met: the record holds qualifying evidence and nothing attested contradicts it
status_semantics.not_met: the record holds evidence that the criterion fails
status_semantics.missing: the record holds no qualifying evidence either way; name what to ask the provider for
status_semantics.conflicting: a structured value on the request form disagrees with the record on a fact this criterion depends on; takes precedence over met and not_met. Absence of a record is missing, never conflicting.

criteria.requirement: Type 2 diabetes mellitus, active, documented in the record
HbA1c >= 7.0 % on a result dated within 90 days of the request date
At least 90 days of metformin therapy falling within the 12 months before the request date, OR documented intolerance or contraindication to metformin

path_a.duration: from authoredOn to dispenseRequest.validityPeriod.end, or to the request date if still active

criteria.requirement: No history of pancreatitis, medullary thyroid carcinoma, or multiple endocrine neoplasia type 2, at any time

fhir.note: A resolved or inactive Condition still counts as history. Match the listed codes or their descendants.

criteria.requirement: Age 18 or older on the request date
BMI >= 27 kg/m2 on a result dated within 365 days of the request date

decision_rule.otherwise: clinician_review, with missing_documents naming exactly what the provider should send
decision_rule.forbidden: The service assembles evidence only. It never recommends or makes a determination of any kind; licensed clinicians do.

attestation_handling: Where the prescriber attestation and the record disagree, mark the criterion conflicting and cite both.
